products.name: Desmos
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI features: none recorded. Use: Graphing calculators and classroom activities. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: Anyone can use calculators without an account; classroom accounts free. Privacy: No signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement listed in one K-12 directory. Price: Calculators free; Amplify Classroom (formerly Desmos Classroom) free; Amplify Desmos Math curriculum paid.
